findings.claim: Drive modeld/app.py differs from frozen Project-Frankenstein modeld/app.py by exactly one semantic replacement: static `PORT = 8090` became an import of `config.instanz` plus `_inst.port("modeld")`. Inverting only those two Drive lines reconstructs the exact frozen Git blob cb89e922f3442b0c699f39b8b63a81d316104ae8.

config/ports.py and config/instanz.py are present in the extracted AICORE Drive tree, modified Aug 4, but absent from frozen Project-Frankenstein head. They establish instance identity, a canonical logical service->port map, a global port displacement, root/path/environment injection, dead-port declarations and prime-vs-twin classification.

UEBERGABE-P2 reports a corrected offset-semantics live test: Prime core 8088 and twin core 8200 ran concurrently for 46 seconds with repeated health checks, separated data root, 15 resolved ports per instance and zero resolved collisions; Prime PID remained stable. The same source explicitly says only the twin core was started and therefore full two-FRANK coexistence was not demonstrated.

With FRANK_INSTANCE_ID=zwilling and malformed FRANK_PORT_BASE=abc, exact Drive ports.py silently falls back to offset 0; modeld resolves to 8090. A malformed twin namespace can therefore collide with Prime resource numbers instead of failing closed.

With twin offset=100 and legacy AICORE_ROUTER_PORT pre-set to 8091, instanz.port(router) resolves 8191 while the preserved environment remains 8091. The compatibility rule 'never overwrite existing variables' can create two simultaneously authoritative addresses for the same logical resource.

The handoff preserves an earlier executable example that used FRANK_PORT_BASE=8200 as if absolute, then later marks it false after the U1 fusion and corrects the semantics to offset 112 for core port 8200. The architecture itself therefore contains a concrete stale-configuration-semantic failure example.

Default configuration preserves modeld=8090 and IST_PRIME=True; offset=100 gives modeld=8190 and IST_PRIME=False; FRANK_ROOT shifts AICORE_DATA/runtime path and service URLs; dead-port access via ports.port(nerd_physics) raises ValueError. These are useful compatibility and namespace-positive controls.
